title: Why Don't You Want To Do Anything After Binging 4 Hours of YouTube Videos...
summary: Dr. K of HealthyGamerGG explains why people feel unmotivated and unable to start tasks after hours of YouTube or similar distractions. He frames it as a result of how social media is designed to capture attention, and says not to blame yourself.
why: Recommended in Ask HN threads on motivation and internet addiction as an accessible explanation of why screen time dulls drive.

quote.text: the video has a more scientific explanation of this phenomenon.
